title: Find companies to approach
summary: A list of companies that look like good customers, found on public web pages by the Researcher.
text: Find companies that match our ideal customer and the kind I describe here: [kind]. In order: first the Researcher searches public web pages for companies of that kind, using only the words I wrote here and never our customer files, and writes its notes with a source for each company. Then Sales reads those notes in the research folder, keeps the companies that fit our ideal customer, and writes a short list with why each one fits and the source for each. Do not contact anyone and do not send anything. Do not invent a company: list only what the notes show, and say so plainly if there are fewer. If I gave a number, aim for this many: [count]
